title: The Master page shows the master's live terminal; only the operator types
description: A real browser against the real control plane, with a stub herdr whose terminal session echoes input: the signed-in operator opens the Master page, sees the pane's screen, types a line, sees it echoed and finds it in history under their name; an unauthenticated handshake is refused; a reader watches read-only; a worker pane opens read-only from Workers; leaving the page releases the stream and closes no pane.

steps.name: Drive the Master page terminal in a browser against the real server
